sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Fort Wilkins Historic State Park campsites via the booking site's /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-09-21; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-25)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site (2027-05-18, 07-13 and 09-21 alike): 20/30-amp sites $37, 50-amp pull-through sites $42. 2026: $35 / $40 (DNR table and booking site). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule ($37 / $42 on 2027-05-18, 07-13 and 09-21; $35 / $40 on 2026-10-27) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Fort Wilkins East & West Campground: 50-amp $40, 20/30-amp $35) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fortwilkins ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: midnrreservations.com resources on the 'East' map (52 sites 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps', 15 '20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps'; all 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No') + campground map PDF (East Campground: sites 25-39 marked '50AMP PULL-THRU SITE'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The East campground map and the booking site's 'East' map both show 67 sites (numbered 1-67), 15 of them 50-amp pull-throughs (25-39). Allowed lengths run 20-45 ft (two sites to 45 ft, nine to 40); seven take tents only. The DNR page's text still says 'sites #1-81' with 20/30-amp on each site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/-/media/Project/Websites/recsearch/documents/MapsE-H/fort_wilkins_camp_map.pdf (East Campground, sites 1-67, '50AMP PULL-THRU SITE' legend) + midnrreservations.com resources on the 'East' map (allowed equipment per site) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fortwilkins ('The east campground (sites #1-81) features multiple loops with sunny sites'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Modern restroom with showers and a laundry in the middle of the east campground; vault toilet at its west end. The park's sanitation station is at the West campground's entrance road. Free WiFi in summer.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fortwilkins ('A laundry facility is available in the east campground near the restroom'; 'A modern restroom with showers is centrally located in the east loop'; 'In the summer months, free WiFi is available in east and west campgrounds') + campground map PDF (East: LAUNDRY, RESTROOMS, VAULT TOILET; West: SANITATION STATION), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fortwilkins ('For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + DNR rates table (reservation season May 15 - October 14), read 2026-10-25

note: East campground of Fort Wilkins Historic State Park at the tip of the Keweenaw near Copper Harbor, on Lake Fanny Hooe east of the restored 1844 fort: several loops of sunny sites, two lake overlook decks and stairs down to the lake, a playground nearby. It has its own entrance road off US-41; the West campground is a separate entry west of the fort. Closed early 2026 for electrical and site upgrades; no closure notice since (rechecked 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-25). --Claude
summary: DNR page + campground and park maps + booking site + DNR rates table: East campground is 67 sites (count new), 15 50-amp pull-throughs (electric only), lengths to 45 ft (max_rig_ft 50 -> 45); showers/flush toilets/laundry/WiFi, park dump station; reservable. Fees 35-40 (2026) -> 37-42 (2027 booking site). Status open (manual) left; no closure notice now. Separate entrance from the West loop, ~1 km apart, so the split stands. Season (derived) left: only the reservation season is published. Note trimmed of field restatements and the stale closure text.
flags: Pin: 47.4662,-87.8680 sits inside the WEST campground (OSM 'Fort Wilkins State Park - West Campground' spans -87.8760 to -87.8683, centre -87.8722), not the East one. The East campground is east of the fort and Fanny Hooe Creek: OSM 'Fort Wilkins State Park - East Campground' centre 47.4661,-87.8585 (bbox -87.8604 to -87.8568), about 0.7 km east of the pin; the DNR park map shows it with its own road off US-41.

Waterfront re-audit lead: the entry is 'not waterfront', but the DNR campground map draws sites 1-10 along the Lake Fanny Hooe shoreline with 'STAIRS TO LAKE' and an overlook deck, and the DNR page says 'two observation decks overlooking Lake Fanny Hooe in the east campground'. The earlier audit may have looked at the wrong place (see the pin flag). Waterfront not changed.

Not a merge: the DNR park map shows the East and West campgrounds on separate roads off US-41 with the fort between them (~1 km apart); the DNR calls them one 'modern campground that includes the east and west campgrounds' and prices them together.

The DNR page text is out of date for this loop ('sites #1-81', 'There is 20/30-amp service available on each site'); its own campground map and the booking site show 67 sites with 15 50-amp pull-throughs.
